structural_change: STEWARD-HBMd/E86 10-23 RT: retimed stage-C compare (RT 1, FAN32 2, SEAM 0). Route f67e2e265 (v4b FAN32 2 + SEAM 1) TT -30.32 ps / 469 endpoints, ALL = compare operand (SX 185, q_bg 186, cap 41, cs 24, p_bg 18, xs 15) -> 85-b ot_tkm_lt_live -> GN leaf -> gc copy in ONE edge (Codex v7/v7b placement -30.1/-61.9 same class): logic depth, not geometry (GRT 0, uniform 47%). RT registers every compare one edge early (RX per position, ZR / GB / RB per group, operands = per-group regional N copies of the block) and the X select (SL), so stage C = flop -> 2-level AND-OR -> GN leaf -> gc. +1 input edge per chain hop (tkm_static TLAT 4 -> 5, SETTLE 5 NT + 8, tap conv_pipe[3]); SEAM/cap dropped. Lockstep vs PRE1 CREP0 reference with REF controls delayed one edge (MUT0 PASS, CMUT 1/3/5/6 FAIL). MAIN 302.4 sq + up_in capture flops (X[60..63], the conveyor seam's pin registers) FIRM-anchored at the S face (upin_anchor.tcl, coordinator review: pin->reg p90 142 um).
